scripts.generate:api: npm run export:schema && openapi-generator-cli generate -i ../openapi.json -g typescript-fetch -o src/api --additional-properties=supportsES6=true,typescriptThreePlus=true,useSingleRequestParameter=true,modelPropertyNaming=original
scripts.generate:sdk:python: npm run export:schema && openapi-generator-cli generate -i ../openapi.json -g python -o ../sdk/python --additional-properties=packageName=codevideo_client,projectName=codevideo-client-sdk,packageVersion=0.1.0
scripts.generate:all: npm run generate:api && npm run generate:sdk:python
